Invariant: a valid partition remains within the search interval. A partition is valid when leftA ≤ rightB and leftB ≤ rightA; since each array is sorted, every left-side element is then at most every right-side element. If leftA > rightB, move the cut left; if leftB > rightA, move it right. These violations exclude all cuts farther in the wrong direction.

At a valid partition, an odd total returns the larger left boundary; an even total returns the average of the larger left boundary and smaller right boundary. Treat missing left boundaries as −Infinity and missing right boundaries as Infinity. This handles one empty array, cuts at either end, duplicates, negative values, and single-element totals; both arrays empty is excluded by the contract. Searching the shorter array keeps j within bounds and uses O(log(min(m,n)+1)) time and O(1) extra space.

Use a stack of indices, initially containing the boundary sentinel −1. Scan s: push each opening parenthesis’s index; for a closing parenthesis, pop once. If the stack becomes empty, push the current index as the new invalid boundary. Otherwise, update the maximum with the current index minus the stack’s top.

Invariant: the stack holds the current invalid boundary followed by unmatched opening-parenthesis indices. After a matched closing parenthesis, the index at the top is the boundary immediately before the longest valid substring ending here, so their difference gives its length.

Boundary cases: an empty string or only unmatched parentheses returns 0. Leading unmatched closing parentheses reset the boundary; trailing unmatched opening parentheses cannot extend a valid substring. Nested and adjacent valid groups both work: "(()" returns 2, and ")()())" returns 4.

Time is O(n), and auxiliary space is O(n).
